name: Mutters
kurzbeschreibung: Vacation spot in the Mittelgebirge with the Mutterer Alm, Mutterer Höhe, and the famous Pfarrkirche with its onion-shaped tower.
beschreibung:
Mutters is situated at an elevation of 830 meters on the sunny Innsbruck Mittelgebirge plateau, just a few kilometers south of Tyrol's capital city, in the district of Innsbruck-Land. Home to around 2,200 residents, the village is conveniently reachable via the historic Stubaital Railway (Stubaitalbahn) or by car, while the modern Muttereralmbahn cable car connects the plateau with the alpine peaks above.

🏔️ The heart of outdoor recreation is the expansive Mutterer Alm area – a scenic alpine mountain park offering leisurely panoramic walking paths, adventure playgrounds, a mountain reservoir lake, and the scenic summit of Mutterer Höhe with sweeping views spanning the Inn Valley and the Nordkette range. In winter, family-friendly ski slopes, practice lifts, and toboggan trails attract visitors of all ages, while summer offers wonderful hikes toward the Raitiser Alm and Pfarrachalm.

In the village center stands the late-Gothic parish church of St. Nicholas with its prominent onion-shaped bell tower, serving as the proud landmark of Mutters. Cozy traditional inns and mountain huts serve hearty Tyrolean dishes like Kaspressknödel and Kaiserschmarrn. Mutters uniquely combines immediate proximity to the city of Innsbruck with authentic mountain nature and family-friendly recreation.
